As a civil rights attorney, consumer advocate, San Francisco Supervisor, and the California Director for Bernie Sanders and the Working Families Party, Jane Kim has spent her career expanding opportunity and affordability for working families in California.
And as the only Democratic candidate not taking a dime from the insurance industry, fossil fuel industry, corporate PACs, or self-funding her campaign, Jane is ready to be the independent voice Californians deserve.

## About The California Insurance Commissioner
##### The Most Important Job You've Never Heard of
An under-the-radar and under-leveraged office, California’s Insurance Commissioner oversees the $3 trillion home and auto insurance industry in California.
The office is tasked with protecting consumers from fraud, licensing insurers and enforcing state law as it pertains to the industry. In recent years, the Commissioner has also taken on a role in climate change mitigation and disaster recovery.
California's Insurance Commissioner should be more than a regulator: the office can and should be a champion for working people across the state.
Because California’s affordability crisis isn’t just about rising costs — it’s about political courage. Insurance companies are making record profits while raising premiums, denying claims, and canceling coverage.
I’m running for Insurance Commissioner because this office is a powerful platform from which we can advance a bold agenda for working families.
#### Insurance Industry Stats:
Seven of California’s top 12 home insurers have reduced coverage or exited the market since 2022. [Source]
Ordinary Californians are facing greater risk of being unable to find and afford insurance [Source]
Since 2022, family premiums in California have risen ~24%, outpacing wage growth and inflation. [Source]

At a time when insurance companies are raking in record profits while working families struggle to afford coverage, Californians need an Insurance Commissioner who will stand up to powerful corporate interests. Jane Kim has spent her career fighting for working people, and she is the bold and thoughtful leader California needs right now.
###### U.S. Senator Bernie SAnders
"Jane understands the challenges facing Californians and how to make our government work better for everyone. I’m proud to support Jane for Insurance Commissioner because she will bring the kind of smart, values-driven leadership we need to tackle the insurance crisis and protect California families."
###### LT. Governor eleni kounalakis
“Having served in public office with Jane, I have seen her time and time again stand up against giant corporations and fight for our working people. Jane is the fighter and innovator we need as our next State Insurance Commissioner.”
###### STATE CONTROLLER MALIA COHEN
Jane Kim has fought with and stood alongside workers for the entirety of her career and will continue to champion working people’s causes. In our fight for democracy, we know Jane will have the backs of California workers.”
###### david huerta, president of seiu california
“Insurance decides who can build wealth in this state, and who is protected when things go wrong. Jane Kim will turn this office into a real watchdog for consumers. I’m proud to support her because she understands what’s at stake and will fight to make insurance fair for the people who depend on it.”
###### barbara lee, mayor of oakland
“I’m proud to endorse Jane Kim because she fights for working people and holds powerful interests accountable. As Insurance Commissioner, she will take on corporate greed and protect consumers so families can afford the coverage they need.”
###### rep. pramila jayapal, lead sponsor of medicare for all
